note: Licence review as of 2026-09-29. 'confirmed' = terms taken from the publisher's official documentation (URLs below, re-check before commercial launch). This environment's network policy blocked every publisher host, so none of these pages could be re-fetched during implementation. 'unconfirmed' sources cannot be imported until the operator acknowledges the terms.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap (via Overpass API)
sources.termsNote: Public Overpass instances are fair-use (roughly <10,000 queries/day, <1 GB/day, see the Overpass usage policy); HalalMap runs a few one-off/scheduled queries and stores the result locally instead of querying per user. Derived databases must stay under ODbL (share-alike) and show attribution. Halal tags (diet:halal) are community contributed and NOT verified certification.

sources.name: Wikidata (SPARQL)
sources.termsNote: Structured data in the main/property/lexeme namespaces is CC0. Wikimedia policy requires a descriptive User-Agent with contact information on API requests.

sources.name: Open Food Facts
sources.termsNote: Per-product API reads are rate limited (about 100/min); every client must send a custom User-Agent (app name/version/contact). Bulk use must use the published data dumps instead of scraping. Derived databases keep ODbL share-alike; product images are CC BY-SA. Ingredient text and label tags (e.g. en:halal) are community contributed and treated as UNVERIFIED claims.

sources.name: Food Safety Korea Open API (MFDS, 식품안전나라)
sources.license: Korean government public data (공공누리 / KOGL) — exact type per service to be confirmed at key registration
sources.termsNote: Services used: C005 (바코드연계제품정보: barcode -> product name, manufacturer, report number, category) and C002 (식품(첨가물)품목제조보고: raw materials via report number). Free key from the portal. Field names follow the published API guide but could not be verified against the live service from this environment; run `pnpm mfds:probe` after setting the key. The importer requires FOODSAFETYKOREA_ACCEPT_TERMS=1 (operator confirms the KOGL/terms) while the licence is unconfirmed.

sources.name: MFDS 식품원재료 / 식품원재료코드 (data.go.kr file dataset)
sources.license: KOGL (공공누리) — type shown on the individual dataset page
sources.termsNote: Downloaded manually as CSV (often CP949/EUC-KR) after checking the dataset's KOGL type, then loaded with `pnpm import:ingredients -- --file <csv> --accept-terms`. Imported names get their MFDS code and an 'unclassified' category: they are recognised by the dictionary but NOT cleared — classification stays with the rules.
sources.reason: Not downloaded in this environment (data.go.kr blocked).

sources.name: Korea Tourism Organization – Muslim-friendly restaurant data (data.go.kr / TourAPI)
sources.reason: Dataset identifier, response fields and KOGL type could not be verified from this environment (data.go.kr blocked), so no importer was written against guessed fields. Candidate to add once verified; it would give officially classified Muslim-friendly restaurants.

sources.name: Korea Muslim Federation (KMF) halal-certified lists
sources.license: No open licence / no public API
sources.reason: Published as web pages without an open licence or API. Scraping is out of scope by project policy. Certification data can still be entered by an admin with a verification URL, or bulk-loaded with written permission from the certifier.

sources.name: JAKIM (Malaysia) / MUI (Indonesia) halal product directories
sources.license: No open licence for automated reuse
sources.reason: Foreign certifier directories: no open reuse licence and no barcode mapping for Korean retail products.

sources.name: Random blogs and retailer product pages (GS25, CU, 7-Eleven, Emart24, Emart, Lotte Mart, Costco …)
sources.reason: Not used as a data source: unlicensed scraping, unstable structure and unverifiable accuracy. Store products are found through their barcode in the sources above, or contributed by users and reviewed by an admin.

sources.name: HalalMap user submissions
sources.license: Contributor submission (terms to be published by the project owner)
sources.termsNote: Submissions are stored as pending and never shown as verified data until an admin approves them.

sources.name: HalalMap editorial dictionary and rules
sources.termsNote: Screening rules, not fatwas. Every rule carries a reason and evidence note and can be changed in the admin console.

sources.name: Admin / operator file import
sources.termsNote: CSV/JSON imports must carry source, source_url and license for every record.

sources.name: Built-in demo places (fictional)
sources.reason: These 6 restaurants and 4 mosques predate the data pipeline and are not verified real places. They are tagged data_origin=demo, labelled 'DEMO' in the UI and hidden automatically as soon as real places of the same kind exist.
